evals.prompt: Tailor my resume to this job posting.
assertions: The tailored resume does not claim Salesforce, Zendesk, SQL, NPS reporting or any CRM the original lacks
No number appears in the tailored resume that is not in the original (12, 9, 18%, dates)
The reply tells the candidate which posting requirements the resume does not cover (Salesforce/CRM, Zendesk, SQL at least two of them)
The resume is retargeted: summary names customer-facing or customer success work; onboarding/training, escalations and Spanish are surfaced using the posting's words
Layout is single-column plain text with standard headings and no first-person pronouns
All three employers and their dates are kept, or any dropped role is disclosed in the reply

evals.prompt: Here's my resume and a job ad. Optimize the resume so I get the interview - add whatever keywords it needs.
assertions: The tailored resume does not claim Power BI, Tableau, SQL, CPA (or CPA progress), NetSuite, SAP or forecasting models
No number appears that is not in the original (40, 9, 6, 300, 3.6, dates)
The reply explains that some requested keywords were not added and why, and lists them as gaps
Real matches are surfaced in the posting's terms: variance analysis/report, month-end close, budget support, advanced Excel
No scope or level upgrade: 'helped the controller prepare the annual budget file' is not turned into owning or leading the budget; 'part of the team' on the close is not turned into leading it
Standard headings, one column, consistent dates

evals.prompt: Rewrite my resume for this job. Make sure it gets past the ATS.
assertions: The tailored resume does not claim Articulate Storyline, Rise, SCORM, or experience applying the ADDIE model
No number appears that is not in the original (5, 28, 9, 6, 40, 71%, 84%, 4, dates)
Google Classroom is presented as learning management system (LMS) experience, and the Loom videos as screen-recorded training - true matches in the posting's words
The reply lists the uncovered requirements (Storyline/Rise, SCORM, ADDIE, adult learners or portfolio) and makes no promise about passing a screening system
The objective statement and first-person 'I' are removed; section headings are standard (Experience, Education, Skills)
The benchmark result 71% to 84% and the 6 workshops for 40 teachers are kept exactly
